description: This file defines the 'PubSubSubscriptionState' class, which models the state of a subscription in a publish-subscribe streaming system within Orleans. It includes properties for subscription identifiers, stream identifiers, consumer information, filter data, and subscription states. The class offers methods for equality checks, state management, and string representation.

classes.name: PubSubSubscriptionState
classes.description: Represents the state of a publish-subscribe subscription, including identifiers, stream info, consumer info, filter data, and current state. Provides methods for equality, state management, and serialization-related functionalities.

methods.name: AddFilter
methods.description: Sets the filter data for the subscription.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality against another object or PubSubSubscriptionState instance.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality against a GuidId for the subscription.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the subscription ID.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Equality operator for two PubSubSubscriptionState instances.

methods.name: operator !=
methods.description: Inequality operator for two PubSubSubscriptionState instances.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the subscription state.

methods.name: Fault
methods.description: Sets the subscription state to Faulted.
